Name: Seasonal Alex Revised
Author: sunshineydays
Description:
Right off the bat, not my art! Uses the cute Alex portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11321]Alex Revised by stanloona420[/url] ﻿and the cute outfits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by Poltergeister.[/url] I’ve just combined them and done a little modifying to make the outfits fit the new build.

Cute, chill Alex! For use with the Seasonal Outfits mod. Changes all Alex portraits and a few sprite sheets. Uses the outfits from Seasonal Outfits except for:
[list]
[*]Spring (new shirt)
[*]Flower Dance (new suit)
[*]Luau (flower necklace is now plumerias)
[*]Fall (blue jacket from Alex Revised now)
[*]Spirit’s Eve (now maskless)
[/list]
Just install like normal (manually or by mod manager) and it should work!

I also added a new portrait option for all portraits! It's a playful wink, because sometimes you just need that in your life.

[b]
Modding[/b]
If you'd like to edit other Alex portrait mods to have a wink the way I have:
[list]
[*]delete the white square in the last portrait position
[*]copy and paste Alex's happy portrait to that position
[*]copy and paste his blushing portrait open eye on top of the closed one
[/list]
And if any other dialogue mod wants to use the wink portrait, the reference is $11![b]
[/b][b]

Permissions Specifics:[/b]
For Seasonal Outfits, I've excluded assets designed by artists that aren't Poltergeister, as the artists are excluded from Seasonal Outfits permissions and all either aren't easy to find or contact, or have explicitly stated on their profiles that they no longer wish to be contacted about mod art permissions. I’ve done my best to make not-terrible replacements for those elements, listed above. So, not quite the same, but hopefully nothing egregious!

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]This is my first portrait mod and it was a struggle for me to figure out how to get the portrait coding to play nice with Seasonal Outfits, so please let me know if there are bugs.
[*]I am not interested in doing any other portrait mods! Just wanted to share stanloona420’s cute Alex with more people. He’s too cute not to be seasonal.
[/list]
